modules.name: Reasons to Choose UAGC

props.heading: Reasons to Choose UAGC
props.subheading: Focused courses, real support, and a format built around your life — not the other way around.

highlightCards.title: One Focused Class at a Time
highlightCards.description: Take one course in 5- to 6-week blocks. No juggling four classes. 92% of students study while working full time.

highlightCards.title: Try Your First Course Free
highlightCards.description: Test the format for 3 weeks with no financial commitment. If it's not right, walk away — no cost, no obligation.

highlightCards.title: Transfer Up to 75% of Your Credits
highlightCards.description: Bring credits from community colleges, military training, and professional certs. Average students transfer 41.5 credits.

highlightCards.title: Transparent Costs, $0 to Start
highlightCards.description: No application fee. No enrollment deposit. See actual per-credit costs before you commit.

modules.name: Skepticism Buster

props.heading: Straight Answers to Real Questions
props.subheading: We know what you're wondering. Here's the truth.
props.softCta: Still have questions? Talk to an advisor — no strings.

cards.question: Is this a real, respected university?
cards.answer: UAGC is regionally accredited by WSCUC — the same body that accredits Stanford, UCLA, and the University of Arizona main campus. Your degree carries the same institutional accreditation weight.
expandedDetail: Part of the University of Arizona enterprise
98,000+ employers on Handshake recognize UAGC graduates

cards.question: What does it actually cost — before I give you my info?
cards.answer: Undergraduate courses are $485 per credit. Graduate courses are $625 per credit. Application fee: $0. And 86% of UAGC students receive financial aid or scholarship assistance.
expandedDetail: Average students transfer 41.5 credits (= real dollar savings)

cards.question: Will my existing credits actually count?
cards.answer: You can transfer up to 75% of your credits from community colleges, other accredited schools, military training, and professional certifications. Average students transfer 41.5 credits. Get a free, no-obligation credit evaluation before you commit.
expandedDetail: Credits from 25+ years ago can count
